skills.name: Common-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that already have a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Find common denominators
skills.definition: Rewrite unlike-denominator fractions as equivalent fractions with a common denominator before subtracting.

skills.name: Mixed and whole number representation
skills.definition: Interpret and convert among whole numbers, mixed numbers, and improper fractions when setting up a subtraction.

skills.name: Regrouping for subtraction
skills.definition: Borrow or regroup from the whole-number part when the minuend's fractional part is smaller than the subtrahend's fractional part.
